items.description: As AI agents increasingly write, analyze, and rewrite low-level code, generic toolchains become a bottleneck. Security researchers need semantics they can trust — deterministic compilation on the way in, and faithful decompilation on the way out. In the age of AI, everyone needs their own compiler and their own decoder.

items.title: NeverC — The AI-friendly C23 compiler for security research. Pure C23, integrated linker, DynCode pipeline, cross-platform PE/ELF/Mach-O generation, compile-time string encryption, and a plugin API spanning 130+ compiler phases — designed so LLM-generated code compiles correctly more often than C++ alternatives.

NeverD — The AI-friendly binary analysis & decompilation engine with 1:1 instruction-level lifting. PE/ELF/Mach-O support, strict semantic fidelity, structured C and LLVM IR output, binary rewrite, and a pure C SDK () built for CLI tools, integrators, and AI agents.
NeverC & NeverD — Your Compiler & Decoder for the AI Era
